local_side_channel_policy: Local-only machine-to-machine conversations, desktop heartbeat notes, and private thread prompts are non-authoritative unless also made GitHub-visible.
required_open_machine_behavior: Inspect current GitHub branch/PR-visible coordination records before acting.
Publish cross-lane tasks, blockers, ordering, and involvement requests as GitHub-tracked artifacts.
Do not rely on local machine conversations to direct other lanes.
Preserve source-canon-first, credential, source-license, raw-source, and clean-checkout boundaries.
global_research_program: Record provenance, URLs, hashes, language/topic evidence, and license/access signals.

When sufficient baseline witnesses exist for the offered language/topic scope, begin scoped draft translation and interlinear or semi-constructed interlanguage construction for covered rows while preserving gap status for uncovered rows.
Keep generated translations separate from source-corpus evidence.
Do not publish raw source bodies, zip primaries, credentials, runtime caches, or unredacted secret-shaped values through rolling packages.

source_canon_sufficiency_transition.rule: Source-canon-first is a prerequisite, not an endless holding pattern.
sufficient_baseline: target-language source witnesses relevant to the mathematical topic and register, with TeX/LaTeX/source archives preferred
or strong official, academic, or community PDF/DOCX/HTML/text provenance with explicit source-package gaps
language/topic coverage, source URLs, hashes, and license/access signals recorded
known gaps and weak witnesses explicitly marked
no credential, raw-source-body, OCR-cache, or package-safety blocker
required_after_sufficiency: produce draft target renderings for covered rows
produce source-context notes and term alternatives
produce interlinear or semi-constructed interlanguage/linguistic scaffolds where useful for register comparison
keep uncovered rows in source-acquisition or gap status

publication_authority: Package/steward lane publishes coherent, safety-checked GitHub artifacts from the clean checkout; language lanes do not push directly.
